steps.name: In the Time of the Front Side
steps.objective: Complete the quest in the 「Quiet Place in Orcarium」.

steps.name: The Answer Sought from the Gardener
steps.objective: Talk to the person you met in the 「Quiet Place in Orcarium」, then go to 「Atlas Garden」 and meet [Metheus]. Then turn in the quest to [Jiendia] in 「Dragon Emperor's Palace」.

lines.text: (As though rising from the depths of sleep, %s gradually begins to hear the sounds of the world that had fallen still.)
(As %s opens their eyes, Jiendia comes into view, looking around in confusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, you weren't here a moment ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Thank goodness? A moment ago, I was meeting Lord Aaron to ask about my retainer's whereabouts...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Where has Lord Aaron gone? No, this is... Ah...
(As something returns to her, Jien sinks helplessly to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s... I never wanted to remember that time again, but now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm sorry. It feels so much like that time...
(Jien rises and gazes blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Today feels much like the day I was bound to the altar by that curse.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: A dagger bearing the power of Lux, a lord of the Demon Realm, thirsted for my blood and wounded me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: And Aaron was holding that very blade until a moment ago. You saw it too, didn't you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There must be a reason you appeared before me now, when there was no trace of you moments ago.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I imagine it is no ordinary matter, but please trust me and tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know where to begin... It will be a long story.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: That is all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...
(You tell Jien about Atlas Garden, the visions of Kaina, Empress of Silvaria, and your visit to Vigrid on the Reverse Side.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There is much I do not understand, but I will believe you. You are the one telling me, %s, and I myself was once among the world's impossible things.
(Jien looks up at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I'd been stronger, I could have saved him...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: No. The witch planned this deliberately. Levi... My retainer would not have escaped easily, even if he had been as strong as you, %s.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I should have warned him about the witch beforehand, but I failed to. I bear some responsibility.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: ...In any case, we must keep searching for him. But %s...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: You said the Empress of Silvaria's visions have never been wrong?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: If you had merely watched, I would have been killed or wounded. You couldn't bear that, so you intervened, and things went awry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... So we need to find a way to resolve the situation.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The Front Side and Reverse Side, divided around one person. Just as resolving matters on the Reverse Side brought you back, there must be something to do on the Front Side...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, we should go to Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There is something I wish to ask the garden's gatekeeper. Perhaps we can find an answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does she intend to ask?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It could be dangerous. Are you sure?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I am. Don't worry too much. I won't be a burden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Lady Jiendia. Follow me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: A large bubble rose before us. We merely touched it, and it brought us here. We were down there only a moment ago...
(Jien looks at Laran Road below the garden.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, there's someone on top of that building.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...
(Just as Jien said, someone watches from a white building standing above a pool.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, stand back.
Clink, clink.
(Each slow step Metheus takes is accompanied by the metallic sound of machinery.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Metheus...
(The divine creation, gleaming a beautiful silver-gray, beats its wings powerfully and approaches the two.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: A being made by a god to guard the garden...

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Follower of the gods. You must be prepared when next we meet...」
(Speaking as though in warning, Metheus suddenly stops. It seems about to move again, only to freeze once more.)
Clink, clink.
(Metheus' motionless body repeatedly twists into unrecognizable shapes. When it finally settles, a bladed fan forms in its hand and unleashes a vast wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, get clear!
(After making sure Jiendia has taken cover behind a garden structure, the adventurer charges into Metheus' blade-like winds.)
(You strike at Metheus as its body begins to twist once again.)
Krrrra-boooom!
(The instant %s's attack touches Metheus' wing, a tremendous vortex erupts, blowing away everything nearby.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay back, Lady Jiendia. Metheus will attack again...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Look over there, %s.
(%s follows Jien's pointing hand. Somehow already airborne, Metheus hangs in the sky, staring into the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it looking at?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: What lies to the west?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A village along Laran Road. Luria Village... Don't tell me it's going after the village...?
(At that moment, Metheus rises and disappears from view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did it go?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Calm down, %s... Metheus will not leave this place. More precisely, it cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'll explain when we speak with Metheus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... I thought getting a conversation would be difficult. I was right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, something is wrong with Metheus. I don't think we can avoid a fight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So as soon as we see it, get as far away as you can. Understood?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Understood. Then let us hurry.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I don't think I can remain here much longer...
(As %s expected, a battle begins the moment you encounter Metheus, whose presence feels different from before.)
(After several exchanges of blows, Metheus stops moving and turns toward Jien, who is hiding in the distance.)
Clink, clink.
(With an eerie sound, Metheus retreats rapidly.)

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: %s, stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus has stopped moving... Metheus, can you hear me?
(Metheus quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't intend to fight?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...Correct, follower of the gods.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop calling me 'follower of the gods.' Use my name. Isn't that a bit long?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Your name is %s...?」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...%s. Who stands beside you?」

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: You may call me Jien, from the continent of Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Jien... You must not remain here long.」

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I know. I only came to hear what you have to say, then leave.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Without realizing it, I mistook you for a god. Jien, your time... and %s's time... are both slightly out of alignment...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「You carry the air of a world that stopped in twilight...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「When you approached, my time twisted. And all the garden's time was shaken...」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「At this moment, beyond even the star's god to alter, if you attempt to meet the God of the Astral Realm, everything in this moment will stop.」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「You must return. You must turn it back.」

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: There's a way to turn it back?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「Truth does not lie here. The truth of time is buried elsewhere.」

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Do you know where?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...I am a gardener. The Tear of Time has vanished somewhere.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Tear of Time?
(Metheus unfurls its folded wings and rises into the air.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「...Jien, you will know. The place where the time you carry begins.」

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: ...That answers my question, Metheus. Thank you.
(As Jien gives her thanks, Metheus turns away and flies off.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Jiendia, was that enough?

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Metheus told me everything it knows, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? It never said where to go.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The place where my time began to fall out of alignment. Dragon Emperor's Palace.

steps.name: A Clue Left by Truth
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Jiendia] in 「Dragon Emperor's Palace」, then go to meet [Guiyi] inside 「Dragon Emperor's Hall」.
2. After the conversation, return to [Jiendia] in 「Dragon Emperor's Palace」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I never thought I would stand here and look upon Dragon Emperor's Palace again...
(Overcome by memories, Jien gazes at Dragon Emperor's Palace, unable to continue.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been so long since I came here, too.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: So much has happened to both of us, %s.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: The phantoms of time that filled Dragon Emperor's Palace have all been dealt with... I want to keep restoring it, until one day people can come and go freely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going to see Lord Guiyi. If you have a message for him, tell me.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't be. Thanks to you, Lady Jiendia, I can see what I need to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Guiyi may know about the Tear of Time Metheus mentioned.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I have so much to tell Lord Guiyi, but I'll hold back for now. I feel too sorry...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I've tried so hard, but I struggle even with my own time. I still haven't found a way to let him leave...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Please don't blame yourself.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Thank you, %s...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Then just tell him I miss him dearly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will... I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'd better hurry...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm definitely back, but everything feels slow. This situation clearly isn't normal...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to resolve this quickly...)
(Where an emperor once pursued the glory of the past, only faint traces remain of a foolish dragon's struggle after failing to ascend.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing has changed here. No one can enter, after all.
(Then a man slowly approaches, lit by the sunlight falling through gaps in the ruined building.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lord Guiyi.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's you... %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well? I'm sorry. I failed to keep my promise to return with a way to help you.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: ...Have I been well?
(Guiyi looks at %s in puzzlement.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: How long has it been since your last visit?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: About a year...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I see. So much time passes, yet what I feel moves so slowly.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It cannot be helped. Someday even this will become familiar. At least it is better than sleeping, trapped in time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: But %s...
(Guiyi looks a little surprised, as though sensing something from %s.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Your presence feels different. More than simply having grown stronger.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Almost like me, moving while enclosed in a barrier of time...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: %s, I will help you. Tell me what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Lord Guiyi... This is how it began...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly recount what happened after Dragon Emperor's Palace: traveling to another continent, meeting Iris, and the events leading to your current situation.)
(Guiyi listens to all that has happened to %s with astonishment.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: After going through all that... Are you truly all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: You say so, but you must be suffering inside. I'm sorry. Now, to resolve what has happened to you...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Wait. Give me a moment to think. It won't take long. Just a moment.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: The time of the Front Side...
(Guiyi opens the eyes he had closed in thought and looks at %s.)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I don't know whether this will offer a clue...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right. Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I cast a barrier of time over Dragon Emperor's Palace, stopping the flow of time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I could use that forbidden method because of the dragon blood passed down from my ancestors.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Even for a mighty, mysterious creature like a dragon, disturbing the time granted to living beings is difficult...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: But the forbidden book describing how to wield a barrier of time contained these words.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: 「A dragon peered into the realm of the gods and shook time. Someone whispered, seeking to claim that space. In their hands, time became twisted...」

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: At the time, I did not understand exactly what it meant, so I passed over it. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A dragon that touched divine power...?)

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Perhaps my father fell for Lux's temptations because, in the end, he wanted to become a god...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I'm sorry. That seems to be all I can tell you. If you knew a dragon from ancient times, you might learn more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, an ancient dragon? I do know one.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Remarkable. A dragon from ancient times...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He helped me on another continent. He has long served Goddess Seres and Goddess Gaia.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: Then he should be trustworthy. Perhaps he can give you the answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Guiyi. I'll ask about the barrier of time. And a way for you to leave...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: No, %s. Resolve the task before you first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll see you later. I'll try to visit sooner next time.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: It's all right. The passage of time means little to me now anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lady Jiendia asked me to tell you something. She misses you dearly...

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: I see. And tell Jiendia... No. I don't know when, but I'll tell her myself.

lines.speaker: 기이
lines.text: %s. If you need my help, return here. Good luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Guiyi.
(As %s bids him farewell, Guiyi slowly walks out of the room.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels as though the pieces are beginning to fit... I'll say goodbye to Lady Jiendia and go straight to Lord Atkina.

steps.name: To Be Certain
steps.objective: Talk to [Jiendia] in 「Dragon Emperor's Palace」, then find [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I'm glad you found a clue. And Lord Guiyi seems to be well...
(As she listens, Jien's expression grows lighter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know where to go, I'll head there right away, Lady Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: I will look for a way to find my retainer. And attend to the matter of Chairman Aaron...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Though it will be difficult to act until I know Her Majesty of Silvaria's current condition...

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: ...I hope your time returns to normal as well, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 지엔
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lord Atkina should be in the Burning Wheel. I'd better go tell him.)

steps.name: One Who Glimpsed the Realm of the Gods
steps.objective: Talk to [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」, then turn in the quest to [Matthias] in 「Luria Village」.

lines.text: (At the boundary of several worlds, where the group once gathered for their decisive battle, a single vast being remains on watch.)
(Sensing an approaching presence during a brief rest, the being quietly raises its head. Eyes gleaming like yellow gems meet the visitor's.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well, Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: As always. With Lady Gaia's blessing, I even visited Xenadia briefly recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's wonderful! How was it?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Simply breathing its air made me happy. I spoke at length with the Sisters and priests who guard Xenadia.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They called me their senior. A slightly unfamiliar way to be addressed. Haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a long way from Eastland to Jiendia. How did you travel?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I returned to my true form and flew to Xenadia. Don't worry. I have my own way of concealing myself.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I wished to stay longer, but could not leave this place unattended for long, so I returned at once. The purification of Avalon and the surrounding area is still unfinished...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I saw spirits that had been moving briskly begin to slow. When I hurried back, even the air inside here felt different.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I asked Shynic, who discovered this place. She said time had been disturbed... Hmm...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: From your expression, you seem to know something. And you have something to tell me. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lord Atkina. The reason I came is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly recount recent events to Atkina.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: So that is your situation...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't seem surprised.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In this land where you, I, and so many living beings dwell, truly inexplicable things happen often.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I won't deny that my long life has made me less easily startled.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In any case, if that is your situation, we must hurry. I'll tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The dragon who peered into the gods' realm, as the maker of that barrier of time described... I knew him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Sanak. He was a Pluton Dragon, like me.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Like me, he awakened at Lady Seres' will to protect life upon the land.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In the twilight age, when the ancient gods and the Twisted One clashed in fierce emotion, and the chaos when the Beast appeared...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: When things vanished before our eyes day after day and everyone struggled to endure their suffering, Sanak happened to open the realm of the gods and look inside.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: After seeing it, he cursed Lady Seres and many other gods. He even tried to kill one of them.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A living creature, however strong, could never rival a god. Not wishing to sadden Lady Seres, that god forgave Sanak and banished him far away.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The god intended to retrieve the object Sanak had taken from the divine realm and return. But that god never came back.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: On the day the Beast brought a god of this world to annihilation... The object fell somewhere and vanished. It never appeared again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Could that object have something to do with time?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The Tear of Time... That is the name the god who forgave Sanak told me.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I don't know what it can do, or why Sanak took it... But it seems to be what you need now.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Gaia once said the Tear of Time might be needed someday. So I searched likely places with the help of a spirit...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia said that?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. A spirit from Pneuma helped me. That was when I learned of the Highlands, in northwestern Freios.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The Tear of Time is probably dormant there. I can't be certain. Its presence was sensed in the area, so you will have to find it yourself.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: We might ask Arche, Pneuma's keeper, but you cannot reach Pneuma or Lady Iris now...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I want to help, but this is all I can do in the current situation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's all right.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Tell me, what did that descendant of dragons look like in dragon form? Similar to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A little different. Oh, I'll sketch it on some paper. He looked like this...
(Atkina falls silent for a moment as he studies %s's drawing of a dragon.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Even a Curiring playing in Dragon Valley could draw better than...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Definitely not a Pluton Dragon. Another dragon clan unknown to me...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: In any case, that descendant's use of a barrier of time means dragon power has already influenced time-related magic.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It seems certain that, after Sanak touched it, that power spread to beings like dragons, or became accessible to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where Sanak is?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The spirits briefly saw him somewhere in the Highlands, but said he soon disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Lord Atkina, I'd better be going.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Will you be all right alone? Others may already have sensed the situation and begun to act...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Why not take someone with you? An ordinary person might not help, but one of the Champions who faced Avalon with us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't they all busy?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: They probably are, but Valdrick should be available.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure Valdrick is busy too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina, I'll go to the Highlands and search for the object you described. If it's there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My time—this whole situation—should return to normal. And I should be able to reach Iris again...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: You will manage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Highlands, where the Tear of Time lies... He said northwestern Freios, didn't he?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll ask Matthias in Luria Village where the Highlands are. That's in western Freios, after all...)

steps.name: The Road to the Highlands
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Matthias] in 「Luria Village」, then go behind [Helena]'s house.
2. Meet [Trisha] and talk to her, then use the village portal to reach 「Invernel Ruins」. Turn in the quest to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」.

lines.text: (Back in Luria Village, everything still seems beautiful and peaceful. Yet Atlas Garden in the distance feels out of place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It may look strange, but nothing serious has happened. It should be all right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How is Iris doing now...? Sigh.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Why is someone so young sighing so much? That won't bring Freios crashing to the ground.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Matthias, Freios mustn't fall! Oh...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Of course it mustn't, and it won't. A joke. Just a joke.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You startled me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought Matthias knew...)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: You looked so troubled, I wondered if something was wrong. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm feeling better now, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I hardly did anything. Glad to hear it, anyway. Tell me whenever you need help. I'm the village chief—no, representative, after all.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Besides, you've helped me so much, %s. I want to help in return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I haven't done anything for you...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Jun, I mean. Jun. Used to be so busy playing with Hefring, but after meeting you, %s, the child actually listens. How did you do it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well... I promised Juen I'd tell some interesting stories.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Haha, that explains it. There have been fewer trips to the ruins and more waiting for your return. Every day, asking Helena and everyone else whether they've seen %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something came up suddenly, so I haven't seen Jun. I can't just now. Could you ask for a little more patience?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Of course. But make sure the stories are good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Oh, right. Matthias, do you happen to...

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Do I happen to what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Know how to reach the Highlands?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: The Highlands? You mean Invernel? Of course.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: The Highlands are the continent's highest region, in the northwest. Invernel is the only village there.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: There have always been many legends, and rumors of sacred power. Religious orders even built facilities there.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: A very unusual place. There are griffins, rare nowadays. Several powers once fought to claim it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It really doesn't sound like an ordinary place.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Follow the main road behind Helena's house until you see the highway heading north. Keep north along it, and you'll reach the Highlands.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: As it happens, a woman from Invernel is here looking for someone to travel with.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Magical beasts and demons began pouring in ten years ago, leaving part of it in ruins. I hear it's still much the same. Too dangerous to travel alone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go with her.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I'd feel reassured if it were you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is she now?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: By the main road, looking for a traveling companion. Shall I tell her someone's willing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No need. I'll go speak to her. Thank you, Matthias.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: It's nothing. Take care on the road and see her home safely. Come visit again afterward.
(Matthias lightly pats %s on the shoulder, then goes inside his house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Thanks to Matthias, I learned quite a bit about the Highlands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To the main road, then.)
What should I do? Just go?
I only need to make it to the ruins somehow. How did I end up all the way here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that her?
(Just as Matthias said, a woman stands by the main road behind Helena's house.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me.
What?
(The woman, striking in her unusual clothing and distinctive henna patterns on her arms and forehead, steps back in surprise.)
What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The village representative said you were looking for someone to go to Invernel with you. Is that right?
(The woman, who had looked close to tears, breaks into a bright smile and takes both of %s's hands.)
Yes! That's right!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then would you like to travel with me?
I'd love to. I need to get back, but I couldn't manage alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you need to get back... Are you from Invernel?
Yes. I was looking for something I'd lost and ended up in Luria. I never thought I'd come so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you find what you lost?
I found it and sent it back ahead, though I wonder whether it made it home. Hehe. Anyway, that's done, so I should return too.
Oh, I haven't introduced myself.
(The woman shakes her head slightly, looking a little embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'm Trisha. Just Trisha, please. No titles needed.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I was born and raised in Invernel. I'm not used to meeting people from elsewhere, so I'm a little awkward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'm from somewhere else myself, so don't worry. I'm %s... Please just use my name too.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Of course, %s. %s...? I think I've heard that name somewhere. Oh, the famous adventurer the priest mentioned...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Likewise. Though I'm not really famous or anything.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hehe. You're modest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow, just looking at her lifts my spirits.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: May I ask what brings you to Invernel, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for something too. Though I don't know if I'll find it...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I see. I don't know what it is, but I'm sure you'll find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Trisha. When shall we leave? I'd like to go right away.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: A griffin never hesitates when it wants to fly. You remind me of one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A griffin...?)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hehe, the griffin was a joke. I know the way, so I'll guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you. Huh...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What was that? I suddenly felt something strange...)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha. I think it's just my imagination.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Oh... That happens sometimes. Hehe. Shall we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(The adventurer looks toward the sky above Laran Road, but only Atlas Garden floats there, unmoving.)
(Shortly after the adventurer leaves Luria Village with Trisha, something enormous appears from the direction of Atlas Garden, seemingly carrying a boy.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What was with that human? They didn't spot me, did they...?
With my time, hiding a little brat like you is effortless.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Who are you calling a brat? Want me to drop you?
(Hanging from the airborne magic golem Licaria by one arm, a woman gives No Name a mocking smile.)
Go ahead and try.
(An ordinary being would fall the moment they let go, but the woman rises lightly into the air like a butterfly.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I knew you couldn't be an ordinary demon if the Grand Duke asked for your help... Well, I'll give you that. Ugh, what are you doing?
(The woman reaches out, seizes No Name's face, and pulls him toward her.)
How much more am I expected to accommodate you?
(The long, sharp horn on the woman's forehead touches No Name's. A sharp cry escapes his lips.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: U-urgh...!!
I am not someone a nameless child like you may look down on. Show some manners, unless you want a hole in your head.
(Along with the pain, red gradually floods No Name's vision.)
Or at least pretend to have some.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: A-all right... S-stop... Queen.
(Satisfied with No Name's answer, the woman called Queen quietly draws back, then reaches out to stroke his head.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Now you understand? You must not be rude to the queen of the Gremory clan.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: There's a good child. Hehe. I'm sorry. I hurt you without meaning to.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: My time will erase your wound.
(As the Gremory Queen speaks, an ominous green light flows from her fingertips toward No Name's wound.)
(Where the queen's light lingers and fades, no trace of the wound remains. Not even the blood that flowed from it.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So this is the queen's power...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Isn't it a little early to be amazed?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Now, little brat, follow that human. I'll inform the Grand Duke.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: All right. Please do...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: See you shortly. I'll catch up.
(With a brilliant smile, the Gremory Queen vanishes as though evaporating.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So irritating...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: We're here. Invernel stretches from this structure to the temple you can see to the north.
(Trisha points to a white temple rising atop the distant rocky mountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Highlands are enormous. I didn't realize even where we're standing was part of the village.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The temple, the homes, and the land managed by the order all belong to Invernel. But this part is in ruins. There's little we can do.
(Where Trisha looks, flowers, trees, and weeds grow wild and tangled among broken structures.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It feels quite different from farther inside, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: We call this the Ruins, and that area the Safe Zone. Both are part of Invernel in the Highlands, but now they're separate districts.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: At some point, demons, devils, and the magical beasts they commanded began appearing. They attacked indiscriminately and destroyed buildings.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The damage has been severe over the past ten years. Almost everything except the north, where the temple stands, is in ruins.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: In the end, at the order's urging and by imperial command, we had to abandon half of Invernel.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That's how it became divided into the Safe Zone and the Ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's so dangerous, why did you ask me to bring you into the Ruins, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I have to come here for my work with the griffins. And there are people who escort me regularly, so it's all right.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire the Highlander, Battle Priest Caluso, and Romalius, our part-time worker, help me. You needn't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A Highlander and a battle priest, I understand. But a part-time worker?)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: This way, %s.
(As you walk and talk with Trisha, someone quietly approaches beside %s and begins walking along.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Don't be startled. I know this one.
(An animal with a quadruped's body, a bird's face, and sleek wings gazes at Trisha, its cheeks flushed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A griffin?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, a griffin. The village children have trouble saying it, so they call them 'grippons.' Now the griffins think that's their name too.
(The griffin pricks up its ears at 'grippon.')

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But griffins...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That's right. Some people consider them magical beasts. The griffins here are friendly with humans, though.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Only the ones raised around people, of course. Hello, Salty.
(The griffin approaches and rubs against Trisha as though reassuring her.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: As a member of the Hallein clan, I oversee the training and taming of griffins. It's been over ten years now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Hallein clan and griffins... Oh... Near the Guild Union...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ahaha... Some griffins went as far as El Anoir and caused trouble. Catching them and sorting it out was quite an ordeal...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I wish we could clear up the Guild Union's misunderstanding, but it hasn't been easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I've done this work for a while, but sometimes I wonder.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Taming wild griffins is good for people. But I don't know whether it's good for the griffins.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It's a choice we've made so our clan and many others can live together. But that doesn't make it the right answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's difficult.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Isn't it? Sometimes I wish there were a right answer. If there had been, perhaps Nirvana...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I've been talking only about myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. Shall we keep going?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, this way.
(As Trisha enters a path among the broken structures, her movements gradually slow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What's wrong?
(The moment Trisha turns back, her slowed movements return to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though time slowed down...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I stepped on something. Just a twig. Ahaha. I suppose I can't help feeling nervous in an unfamiliar place.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Oh, I see. I was nervous when I came all the way to Luria Village, too. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Come this way.

steps.name: The Griffin's Howl
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then defeat [Sinister Kilesa] and [Angel-Winged Nero]. Return to [Trisha] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Here we are.
(After a long walk, the two stop before a half-ruined structure with an old-fashioned air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We've arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Again...)
(Trisha's movements keep slowing and returning to normal, as though time itself were flickering.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This has kept happening since we reached the Highlands...)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, I'll wait here for someone else, then go farther in with them. I have overdue journal entries to write, too...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Head straight north to reach the Safe Zone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are all those things yours, Trisha?
(Objects bearing patterns similar to Trisha's are neatly arranged to one side.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: They belong to the Hallein people. Our people used to live together in this district.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: As more demons, magical beasts, and vicious animals appeared, most left their homeland. The few who stayed live in the Safe Zone.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I've been sorting these things little by little while tending the griffins in the Ruins. It reminds me of my childhood...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Our house used to stand right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. But you tend the griffins here? Isn't it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: There are reasons for that. Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Trisha, what is it?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Can you hear it? Griffins are howling in the distance.
(The griffin that followed you lifts its head to howl as well, but closes its beak when it meets Trisha's eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Reading the room, are you, Salty?
(The griffin named Salty approaches Trisha with an expectant look.)
(As Trisha feeds it with practiced ease, griffin cries echo throughout the Ruins.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: They almost never call all at once like this... What's happening? They used to follow Nirvana's calls, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay here a moment, Trisha. I'll take a look.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: But I should check on the griffins...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. However well you know this place, it could be dangerous right now.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: ...All right. Then promise me you'll come back soon. And won't get caught up in anything bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise, Trisha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait here with this fellow. I'll take a quick look and return.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: All right. I'll wait.

steps.name: Romalius the Demon
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then defeat [Baby Iona] and [Happy Guripong]. Turn in the quest to [Romalius] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No, it can't be. Nirvana... Ah!
(Watching the direction of the cries, Trisha turns and bumps into the returning adventurer.)
(The griffin swiftly catches Trisha's clothing in its beak, steadying her before she falls.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'm fine. Thank you, Salty.
(Trisha strokes the griffin and takes out a treat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing like what you feared, Trisha. There were just more griffins gathered than when we arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking closely, they seemed to be sharing bread someone had thrown to them.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Griffins shouldn't eat human food... Sigh.
(Salty's eyes sparkle at the word 'bread,' but the griffin droops when Trisha frowns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Nirvana, by the way? I think you mentioned that name before we left.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana is... a griffin I grew up with. The first one I ever tamed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'd like to meet Nirvana sometime.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana isn't with me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Across the rainbow bridge...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No, it's not that... One day ten years ago, my family and I encountered demons and magical beasts on our way back from another region.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana had been waiting for us. After saving my family, Nirvana suddenly disappeared.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It had happened before, but Nirvana always came home after a few days. This time, there was no return.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I've searched and searched ever since, but no one anywhere in Freios has seen Nirvana.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: A griffin three times the size of the one here, and no one has seen a thing...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Still, I believe Nirvana is alive somewhere. Such a clever, gentle creature.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure Nirvana is doing well, just as you say.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Do you think so?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Oh, Romalius? What brings you out here...?
(Trisha looks surprised as someone appears behind %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's...
(A silver-haired man with red eyes briefly meets the adventurer's gaze.)
(At that moment, not only Trisha but the man before you slows, then speeds up again. Once more, only the adventurer notices.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha, have you brought a guest? A pleasure. I'm Romalius. I live in Invernel...
(The adventurer spots the black horns on Romalius' head and raises a weapon in alarm. Trisha catches %s's wrist to stop you.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Lower your weapon, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? He's a demon.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius is a demon, but he has changed sides.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Changed sides? How can you trust that?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Lady Lydia, the demigod, broke his horns and made him unable to use magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lydia the demigod?)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha is right. Lydia broke my horns. If you still don't believe me, look at this.
(Romalius takes something from his clothing and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's from the imperial palace...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A temporary residence permit certified by the palace. I also have the Resedia Order's permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something feels strange...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I have no intention of fighting you. If you still don't believe me, kill me now. I won't resist.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, please put the misunderstanding aside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s? Is that your name? I've heard it before. It's good to meet you.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They say you defeated the legion commanders, that noisy crow, and the irritating incubus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you know.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I keep hearing about it, whether I want to or not.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha probably has no idea just how remarkable you are.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I know you're strong, at least. But Romalius, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'm on a part-time job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A part-time job?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I was trimming vegetables in the order's kitchen. Priest Caluso offered double the hourly pay if I'd check for demons nearby.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Even without my powers, I can roughly sense when demons appear. Enough to know they've come to cause trouble somewhere. An inconvenient instinct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Like a radar...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, a good description. I'm a surprisingly useful radar. I've warned them a few times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't they your own kind?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: My own kind... That means nothing to demons. If you're weak, they'll kill you or force you beneath their feet.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Other races can be similar, but I think they're at least better than demons.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius, the sun will set at this rate. Have you finished searching?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Finished ages ago... Oh! I need to hurry to my next job.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Romalius, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Please take our guest into the village when you go back. I'll return with Priest Caluso later.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I'll make you something delicious afterward.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Oh, Trisha's cooking is always welcome. Exactly to my taste.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Trisha, I looked for that griffin too, but couldn't find it. I'm sure it was one I fed...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I see. It can't be helped. I'll look again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Now, %s. Go with Romalius.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you be all right, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Priest Caluso is nearby. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In that case... See you later, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I hope you find what you're looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'm off, Trisha. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: And with you, Romalius. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Some sort of local greeting?)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Come, %s. Follow me. You'll see what a wonderful place it is.

steps.name: Heard Any Strange Rumors?
steps.objective: Talk to [Romalius] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」, then listen to [Daniel] and [Eclair]'s story. Discuss what you have learned near the village's angel statue, then turn in the quest to [Alexis] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: So that's a card personally authorized by the empress. I'm jealous.
(Romalius gazes at %s's card with sparkling eyes.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I've heard it guarantees your identity everywhere and grants every benefit the empire offers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does it? Hmm...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That's how remarkable you are. Acknowledged by the empire, and even by someone like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for saying so. The Safe Zone certainly looks different up close than it did from the Ruins.
(A place combining a temple enclosed by sturdy, fortress-like walls with the homes of people who live in the Highlands.)
(The Invernel Safe Zone feels sacred and serene, yet bustles with life like any other village.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Doesn't it? Maybe because a demigod recommended it, but I love this place.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: They say that ten years ago, the homes stretched all the way down there. It was almost the size of a capital.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Would that make it as big as Pandemonium?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandemonium? The demons'...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Something like home. A place I both love and hate, and never want to return to. Enough of that dull subject.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: %s, you said you came to Invernel to find something. For someone like you to come here...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It can't be an ordinary object. Perhaps it's similar to what the demons are after?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: No need to look so surprised. Haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It might be.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Hmm... I don't know what it is, but I hope you find it first. It'll be put to better use in your hands than in theirs.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not as though you trust me...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I believe in the potential of ordinary life, apart from demons, more than I trust you personally. Trusting humans is at least a better choice than trusting demons.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: No need to overthink it. Just consider me an unusual neighbor. Someone who isn't your enemy.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'd like to show you around myself, but I have a job to get to. We should part here.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Have a look around the village. If you need anything, find Alexis. If Alexis looks unwilling to work, show that card.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Romalius.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's nothing. Just as I'm making the best of my time now, may Nornir bless your time with happiness, %s.
(Romalius gives a light smile and walks toward the temple.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...An unusual demon. Then again, there's Veled. I suppose someone like him can exist too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The best use of my time... For me, that means finding the Tear of Time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask the others for information. Romalius didn't seem to have any particular leads...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (People's movements keep slowing and returning to normal. This can't go on. I need to find a solution quickly...)
(On the main street of Invernel's Safe Zone, someone who looks unlike an ordinary resident surveys the surroundings with sparkling eyes.)
This place looks full of scoops! Squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (One of the beastfolk?)
(Rather than a beastperson, the figure resembles a large parrot dressed for some particular profession.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A reporter? A writer? Doesn't look like an ordinary resident. I should ask.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...
(The large parrot holding a camera recoils at the voice addressing it.)
Aaah! You startled me! Squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...
Do you have a tip to share?
(The large parrot, who had been ending every sentence with a squawk, adjusts its monocle and pretends not to be startled.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A tip? No. I have a question.
Oh-ho, you need information? Squawk? Read my article when it's published...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a reporter?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: I am Daniel, a reporter in pursuit of a scoop. Wherever the story is, I go, go, go! Squawk!
(The parrot introducing himself as Daniel beams and holds up the identification hanging from his neck.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you one of the beastfolk?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: You've got it wrong, squawk. Ah, mustn't let it show. Can you tell, squawk? I mean, can you tell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about... So you aren't?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Correct. I am Daniel, formerly of Monthly Rosengarten's editorial department. Squawk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you're a demon.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: A demon. Correct, squawk.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: H-how did you know?! Squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're from Rosengarten in the Demon Realm, obviously...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Wait. How do you know Rosengarten? Squawk?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: ...Y-you. The one who mercilessly thrashed the dream demons? V-V-Valdrick?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: %s? %s!! Aaaah! Th-the adventurer said to be cruel to demons but kind to the goddess! The adven... adventurer!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Spare me, squawk! Just think of me as a talking parrot! I'm very good at repeating what you say!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, all right. I'll hear you out before I decide.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you... Squaaawk...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Two demons here, not just one. Daniel doesn't look very dangerous, though...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Found any scoops?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Sigh. Not a single one, squawk...
(Daniel sighs and gazes at the distant mountains.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Invernel may not seem to have any big stories, but I intend to investigate thoroughly.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: There are demons and all sorts of people here. I can disguise myself as a parrot beastperson from the next village. Squawk!

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe. A scoop is every reporter's dream, isn't it? Squawk!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dedicated to his profession...)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: In any case, my reporting is perfectly legal. Lady Lydia, a demigod of the Resedia Order, called me an interesting demon and helped me.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: She arranged for the village chief to let me stay. Squawk.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: And she cast a spell that will annihilate this lowly demon on the spot if I do anything wicked. Squawk. I won't, so I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who exactly is this Lydia...?)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hehe. I think a reporter who falls in pursuit of a story is admirable, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I ask a demon...? Romalius said he didn't know.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Exchanging information is the foundation of reporting, isn't it? Squawk. I'll tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daniel, have you sensed any strange power nearby? Or perhaps other demons?

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Hard to say, squawk. Hmm. Meeting Lord Romalius here surprised me, but nothing apart from that.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: To be honest, as a low-ranking demon, I don't understand great powers very well. Squawk. Oh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? So there is something.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: It's off the record, so I'm not sure I can tell you, %s... Squawk...
Grrrowl. ♬
(The sound from Daniel's stomach sends him into a panic.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Ah, ah... I haven't eaten since arriving in Invernel, squawk. Lord Romalius said demons who don't work don't eat. Sniff...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you tell me if I give you this? It's jerky, a specialty from another continent...

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you! Squawk!
(Daniel snatches the jerky from %s's hand and immediately starts tearing into it.)

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Nothing much. A few days ago, squawk! I saw a witch passing through here, squawk! Looking for somewhere to hide!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A witch?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be Hilda? If she was looking for a hiding place... There really must be something here.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Daniel. You look hungry. Have the rest. Good luck reporting. And no mischief.

lines.speaker: 다니엘
lines.text: Thank you, squawk! But where is all this jerky coming from?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (People are slowing down again. I need to gather information and move quickly...)
When will my sister be back?
(A girl with hair so unusual in color that it draws people's eyes watches the village entrance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
(Startled, the girl steps back and catches her foot on something. Surprised as well, %s instinctively reaches out and takes her hand before she falls.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew, that was close. Are you all right?
I-I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry if I startled you.
Oh, n-no. I wasn't startled.
(The girl takes %s's hand and stands, trying to act untroubled. Yet her face is full of alarm.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I'm Eclair. You can call me Claire. And...
(Eclair suddenly panics.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Claire?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I was trying to think how to introduce myself to someone I've never met...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down and take a deep breath. Think of something comforting. You'll feel better.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Oh, yes... Ah, I really do feel better. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me introduce myself. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I could tell you were no ordinary person. Now that I've heard your name, I understand.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: The adventurer who keeps saving people from danger. You're already the talk of the empire...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that remarkable. But Claire, is that a weapon standing there?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Yes. A Spiral Sword, used only by the Highlanders, a people who have long guarded the Highlands.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: We've always needed powerful weapons to protect this place. Over time, they developed this unusual form.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There are so few of us left now that I'm worried. But we don't insist on remaining a tiny elite.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Anyone who wishes to become a warrior following the great earth and sky is welcome. Or simply someone who wants to protect what matters to them.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: So I help train the people who visit from time to time. It gives me practice too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look strong yourself, Eclair.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Oh, n-no. I still have so much to l-learn.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Th-thank you for the compliment.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: But... What did you want to ask?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard any suspicious rumors around Invernel lately? Or has anything strange happened?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There are so many suspicious rumors and strange things, I don't know which to mention.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: A demon like Romalius comes to the village for part-time jobs. A parrot beastperson turns up to report the news.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: ...Oh, lately the griffins driven outside have been disappearing from Invernel. Trisha often goes looking for them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The griffins are disappearing?)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Where is she now? Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I actually came here with Trisha. She's at the site of her house in the Ruins.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness. Thank you, %s. Trisha works so hard. Where have all those griffins gone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... Something does seem strange...)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I'm worried about Trisha. There are so few people left to care for the griffins...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Try not to worry too much, Claire.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Do I look worried? I'm usually good at hiding my feelings...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Oh, what do I do...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've answered some of my questions, Claire.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I'm glad. Knowing Trisha is here in Invernel, I'll try not to worry either. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: If you have more questions, visit the chief. Alexis. Never leaves the area, so you'll find him easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Claire. I'll look around the village a little more.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Goodbye, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
(As though she has something to do, Eclair walks away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That wish for happy time with Nornir must be a local greeting. Everyone uses it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (People are slowing down. Is that time's influence too...? I need to gather information and act quickly...)
(As you explore Invernel's Safe Zone, everyone you see repeatedly slows, then returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something seems wrong with the power of time somewhere in the Highlands...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's take a moment to sort things out...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daniel saw a witch looking for somewhere to hide. Eclair and the villagers say the griffins are disappearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know if any of it is connected to the Tear of Time. Sigh...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Eclair suggested asking the village chief too. I should go.)

steps.name: An Ominous Situation
steps.objective: Talk to [Alexis] in 「Invernel Safe Zone」, then turn in the quest to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」.

lines.text: (A young man whose manner seems out of place in Invernel greets approaching people with a smile.)
(As soon as they leave, he leans wearily against the wall.)
They're gone... Sigh...
(Seeing %s approach, the young man quietly turns his head away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Chief Alexis?
What? Oh, I answered...
(The young man, who looked so drained a moment ago, smiles at his visitor as though nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I'm Alexis. Whether 'chief' is quite the right title is debatable... But how did you recognize me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Claire told me to see Chief Alexis if I had questions.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: So you're the person the villagers mentioned. If you've come to me, you must want to know something important.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I hear you've been asking people about suspicious rumors and unusual events.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Please tell me your name and show any identification you have.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course.
(Alexis accepts the signed card from %s and looks surprised as he examines it.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: How did you obtain such a precious card? Even the council's nobles rarely receive one...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Your name is %s... Ah, so you are %s. I've heard much about you. Unfortunately, from my father's less than favorable remarks...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: The council's nobles dislike those close to the imperial family. Please don't misunderstand. I am different from them, at least.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So he comes from a noble family on the council...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Alexis, are you from Glaston, then?

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Yes, due to certain circumstances. No, to be precise, I opposed my father because his actions betrayed a greater cause, and he threw me out.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Why he insists on such things... It's shameful, so I can't tell you about it. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Just thinking about it exhausts me. I want to rest...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Since I'd been thrown out anyway, I came to Invernel hoping to laze about. Yet somehow I've ended up working so hard as chief!
(Alexis looks thoroughly exhausted.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Forgive me. I meant to mutter that to myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It sounds like you've had a difficult time.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: That aside, I still have a job to do. What brings you to Invernel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for an object. I can't tell you what it is...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: That's all right. There are things I can't discuss either. Let me think of suspicious rumors or unusual events I know about...

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Nothing unusual apart from a demon working hard at part-time jobs and a parrot demon.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: One thing of note is that a demigod has visited frequently lately.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Many demons have appeared recently, so she came to deal with them.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I didn't see it myself, but Priest Caluso said she caught a demon called a Gremory in the Ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Gremory clan? If demons who use the power of time came here, it makes sense that the Tear of Time is nearby.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: I don't know where she went afterward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Alexis. That helped.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Did it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should meet Lady Lydia the demigod later. Then I'll...
(Just as you are about to end the conversation with Alexis, everything in sight begins moving slowly again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, again...)
(As the slow motion continues, a roar like an animal's cry fills Invernel's Safe Zone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...That cry made the slowed time return to normal. What animal was it?)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: The griffins are making a racket again. I've been here a while, but I still need time to adjust. %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. That was a griffin's cry?

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Yes. From the sheer volume, probably a lead griffin. Or 'grippon,' as the children here say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, Alexis. Thank you for talking with me.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Not at all. Hearing that you're leaving is very welcome news.
(Life returns to Alexis' exhausted face.)

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Haha... If you need help with anything else, try someone other than me. Most people in Invernel are kind.

lines.speaker: 알렉시스
lines.text: Then may Nornir bless your time with happiness... Why is my own time so miserable...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I will. Oh, Claire?
(As Alexis leans happily against the wall and stares into space, Eclair runs toward the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, here you are! Did you hear that griffin just now?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? Is there something wrong with a griffin calling like that...?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Nothing wrong, but that was Nirvana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. I was told Nirvana disappeared long ago...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I was about to go to the Ruins when Romalius told me to go with you, %s. Then he hurried off ahead.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: We need to get to Trisha. She'll be wandering through the Ruins looking for Nirvana.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Claire. Let's hurry.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I know a shortcut. Follow me.

steps.name: Where the Wind Lingers
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then explore 「Invernel Ruins」 and enter the suspicious location.
2. After the ominous encounter there, hurry back to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha!
(Spotting Trisha in her usual place, Eclair hurries toward her.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire? %s?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Thank goodness, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thank goodness...? Thank you, Claire. You were worried because I was gone a few days. I'm sorry. I went a little far looking for griffins again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. But Claire, why are you out so early today?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I thought you might go somewhere dangerous looking for Nirvana...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nirvana? I've almost given up looking. Why?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: No, that's not it. Didn't you hear?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Hear what?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Nirvana's cry.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, what are you talking about? Nirvana's cry? %s? %s, did you hear it too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard an animal cry so loudly it shook the village.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, remember how you said Nirvana's cry was different from other griffins'?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes. I studied so hard to tell their calls apart.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Then there's no way you could miss Nirvana's voice ringing through all of Invernel.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Was it that loud? I couldn't possibly have missed a sound that loud...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though the Safe Zone and the Ruins occupy different times and spaces...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Until my situation is resolved, anything could happen. Then...)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, let's go back to the Safe Zone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't know what might happen, so both of you wait here. I'll take a quick look around the Ruins.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Could it be dangerous?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I can't tell you that much. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, let's do as %s says. It will only be a moment. We'll wait here.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: All right, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, I'll be here, so we should be safe.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Our Claire is so dependable.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Th-thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll start somewhere other than the route we took up. There must be something strange...)
(After the adventurer leaves, Eclair surveys the area.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Nothing unusual here apart from little griffins wandering about. Trisha, is there anything on your side...?
(As Eclair addresses Trisha, she stops and stares ahead.)
(A creature beating tiny wings vigorously circles around Trisha.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: A cat with wings?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, what is that?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, lower your guard for a moment. I think this cat is trying to tell me something.
(At Trisha's words, Eclair lowers the hand gripping her Spiral Sword. The winged black cat settles on the griffin Salty's head.)
(When Trisha looks at it, the black cat waves its forepaws in the air.)
Meow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It says it left home with its owner to escape a witch, and they came here. Then they met a demon.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: They thought the demon had come to catch them, so they fled to a safe place they'd found. But the moment they entered, its owner vanished, and it became several cats and grew wings.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I can understand you knowing griffin calls, since you're a trainer. But you understand cats too...?
Meow.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What is it, Trisha?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: It says its owner is trapped in Moksha. What was Moksha again...?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Wait, Trisha. Moksha! It's from that story Priest Caluso told us about a great priest.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Long ago, a priest was drawn by a mysterious power into a strange place somewhere in the Highlands. He couldn't find the exit and only escaped ten years later...
(The breeze that had gently embraced the Ruins stops. Following it, %s naturally comes to a halt as well.)
(Broken Invernel structures had filled your view along the way, but at some point they disappeared. All except one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this place? There's nothing...
(At that moment, a vast black shadow falls over %s. A moment later, something hanging from it drops to the ground.)
Thud.
(A boy with twitching white ears atop his head meets the adventurer's eyes and scowls.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was about to ask you the same thing. Wait. El-Larsa definitely...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yes, I died. That spirit's attack killed me. But I hear it attacked the goddess and got erased?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Don't you think it's hypocritical? A god creates something because it's needed, works it to the bone, then destroys it when it's useless.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: I have a feeling I'll be erased like that someday. But apparently not yet, since I'm still alive.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What will you do, %s? Fight me here? In this place, you'll...
(A mocking smile spreads across No Name's face. Everything in %s's view begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: You'll understand soon, %s.
(As No Name speaks, time slows. Seeming to recognize what is happening, he evaporates from view.)
(Another figure's afterimage appears in his place.)
(As time returns to normal, the hazy afterimage sharpens, revealing someone you would rather not meet.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's been a while. Judging by your expression, our reunion disappoints you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A splendid place, isn't it? Time stands still, and even the wind seems to have vanished. Shall we call it the place where the wind rests?
(Barbatos adjusts his glasses with his familiar mocking smile, then brushes past the wary %s.)
(As the adventurer reaches for a weapon, the presence of metal, colder and sharper than ever, approaches your throat.)
(A woman's voice follows, as cold as the blade.)
So you are the servant of the God of the Astral Realm.
As the Grand Duke's ally, I trust his word, but this time I had my doubts.
Yet here you are. Hehe.
(The horned woman wears a dry smile that suits her pallid skin.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? If you're with the Grand Duke, you must be a demon...
As rude as he said. Addressing me so casually, the queen of the Gremory clan...
(Sighing, the woman withdraws the scythe from %s's throat. The adventurer hurriedly raises a weapon and resumes a defensive stance.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This is the noble queen of the Gremory clan.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: If you must call me something, call me Queen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Gremory Queen... The clan that appeared in the sanctuary...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Those children were like family to me, and you struck them down. Someday, I would like to hold your life in my hand and toy with it...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I know, Grand Duke.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me why you're here.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: So noisy for a mere human. Even if we told you, what do you think you could do?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I merely disturbed this place's time a little. If that brought you here, your own time must be awry.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: You're not denying it. As I thought... Grand Duke.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Yes, Queen?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Allow me to dispose of this human.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There will be time enough after we obtain the Tear of Time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...The Tear of Time! It's here.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Understood, Grand Duke. I'll grant the Astral Realm's god's servant a little time.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Meaningless time, though. There is little you can do while your time is in such disarray.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen, wouldn't it be better to make things a little entertaining?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Did it?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: %s, so long as you are here, you have no choice. With that in mind...
(Barbatos tosses a silver coin, produced from nowhere, into the air. As it lands in his hand, %s's vision shakes.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your luck holds as ever. Depending on how you endure this trial, you may gain time to remain alive...
(Dark shadows swallow the mocking figures of the Gremory Queen and Barbatos, hiding them from view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Queen, have you found the entrance to Moksha?
(Barbatos' voice comes from the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Of course, Grand Duke. I found a structure shaped like a doorway.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Just as I expected, Queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment, Grand Duke, but finding treasure comes naturally to the Gremory clan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's with these demons? Can't they see me?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Where is the doorway?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: There is a human in one part of the Ruins, with a place nearby where griffins gather. That's where it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Near Trisha?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are they saying now? I can't hear...)
(You strain to follow the two demons' conversation, but everything around you seems engulfed by something, and no sound reaches you.)
(After a while, light approaches %s's darkened vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What happened? The demons are gone. Wait. Where was I all that time? I'm clearly in the same place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Focus, %s...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Tear of Time must be in Moksha. That's where those two demons went...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Move. I have to hurry.
(The adventurer hastens behind the statue-like structure and returns to the surrounding Ruins.)
(Above the spot where the adventurer vanished, the still wind begins to blow again. An enormous being, previously hidden from view, appears.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: So this is why we postponed the execution. Amusing.
