(Floating beside the magic golem Licaria, the Gremory Queen smiles at No Name.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Queen, is this the Grand Duke's plan?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Yes. Since someone else is seeking the Tear of Time, he thought it best to trap them in Moksha.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Once you enter this Moksha place, you can never get out?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Even the supposedly all-powerful leader of the Agasura could not be certain of escaping once inside. Does that explain it?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: If even the leader of the Agasura couldn't...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Queen, I found the door.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Well done, No Name. The Grand Duke was right.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: About what?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That No Name can find doors leading to the gods' realm...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: So that's why he came to me.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I wouldn't know. Settle whatever happened between you and the Grand Duke yourselves...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Hehe. Leave what happens inside the Tears of Nornir to me. A little brat like you won't be able to enter anyway.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: A space only those who can wield time may enter. The Tears of Nornir...
(The Gremory Queen smiles with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I'm very much looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Follow me, Queen. I'll show you the door to the Tears of Nornir.

steps.name: The Cat's Owner
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then enter 「Moksha」 and defeat [Lepica]. Return to [Trisha] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, that cat just disappeared, didn't it? R-right here...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Um, Trisha. S-stay calm. I mean...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, get a hold of yourself.
(Trisha takes the panicking Eclair's hands and shakes them.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I must need more training, getting startled by something like this...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Could the cat's disappearance have something to do with %s coming over there?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Who knows...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha! Claire! Everything all right?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Nothing serious, %s, but...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: A cat with wings flew in. Isn't that serious? And Trisha understood what it said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did it say?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: That its owner was trapped in Moksha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, do you know where Moksha is?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Moksha is a place from Highland legends. No one knows where it is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What do I do? Right. Where griffins gather...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trisha, is there somewhere nearby where griffins live together?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Yes. Shall we go together? Just down there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay here, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, I'll go with %s. Stay hidden here. We'll come straight back if anything happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you should do as Claire says, Trisha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: What's happening in the ruins?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: I couldn't hear my missing griffin here, but I could hear it in the village...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: And a winged cat came up and spoke to me...
(Trisha looks at the adventurer anxiously.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know enough to give you an answer yet.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, I think %s is trying to find out, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I wish I could tell her everything...)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: No, I'm sorry. I shouldn't have put you on the spot like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I can promise you this. I won't let you get caught up in anything bad. No... I'll make sure nothing bad happens.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thank you, %s. I'm sure everything will work out.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, the griffins are gathered over there. Follow me. We'll be right back, Trisha.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Okay... Be careful, everyone.
(The resting griffins quietly raise their heads. Eclair takes out some treats and waves them, catching their attention.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: There's a good flock. Sorry I'm not Trisha.
(Eclair throws the treats in the opposite direction with all her strength. The griffins fly off after them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's quite an arm, Claire. Those treats might make it all the way to Luria...
(Eclair flushes with embarrassment.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Th-thank you. But I can't throw them q-quite that far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This angel statue... I've seen a lot of these on the way here.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: They're common in Invernel. They're so finely carved that people used to say angels must have made them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All the others had fallen over, but this one's still standing. Its pose and size are different, too...
(As Eclair walks past %s, her movements slow, then return to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Gremory Queen must be nearby... Where? Behind this statue?)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: The Order made the statues when they built the temple... %s?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Where did you go? %s!
(Eclair looks around. %s, who was standing beside her listening only a moment ago, has vanished.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, where are you? %s?
(All she can see is the praying angel statue and the griffins flying in to rest.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Was this... what %s was worried about?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I have to tell Father Caluso... Oh, right. Trisha first.
(As Eclair hurries back the way she came, someone who has been watching from hiding quietly emerges.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: To think Moksha would accept you so readily...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You have no place in this world. May Moksha keep you captive for a very, very long time...
(A few steps behind the angel statue, the ruined buildings and shattered statues are suddenly gone.)
(Only thick fog and stone blocks engraved with strange patterns welcome the visitor to this new world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This can't be real.
(Blocks fill this impossible world, shifting as though alive.)
(Some float in the air, looking as if they might fly away at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I? I was just... Wait. Is this Moksha?
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. Wh-what was that?
(A vast shadow looms over a hill. Each of its footsteps shakes everything in sight, sending the stacked blocks crumbling, scattering, or soaring into the sky.)
Thud.
(Trying to escape the unknown creature, the adventurer turns back toward the entrance, but can find no path.)
(Only scattered blocks covered in strange patterns, endlessly forming new paths.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How am I supposed to get anywhere? Is the Tear of Time even here? Hm?
(Feeling a tug on their clothes, the adventurer turns to find someone standing behind them.)
(A girl in a cat-eared hat holds the handle of a large suitcase decorated with a cat. She raises a hand in greeting, almost like a salute.)
Hi, hi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
I'm Lepica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here? This place...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Are you trapped here, too?
(The girl who introduced herself as Lepica sighs. She takes a potion from the pouch at her waist and offers it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Want a drink?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That is all right.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Lepica's Alien Red is great for digestion, and it keeps you full when you're hungry.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: It's really good stuff. Or would you like something else? How about Priring Green? Go on, take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Alien Red? Priring Green? Why do all your potions have names like that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: But who are you? What brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My name is %s. I heard there was something here...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s... %s? I feel like I've heard your name before... Anyway, no need to be so formal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, then.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Whatever you heard, %s, there's no Tear of Time here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...How do you know about that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I've spent a week hiding from the monster and looking for a way out. If there were anything like a Tear of Time, I'd have seen it.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Oh, don't let the monster catch you. A woman followed me in here. It grabbed her and crushed her to dust.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I just needed somewhere safe...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: But this isn't the safe place I thought it was.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somewhere safe? Why were you being chased?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: A witch was after me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you're a witch, too...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: No, I'm an ordinary elf... Oh, come on!
(Lepica recoils in alarm.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm not one of those evil witches everyone talks about!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepica, I didn't come here to hurt a witch.
(Lepica grips her suitcase with both hands and swings it wildly. No amount of reassurance seems to calm her.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: They all died right in front of me, just because they were witches... They were people who happened to be different! I never even wanted to become a witch...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Why did a black moon have to rise over my peaceful nights...?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Haah...
(Lepica sighs and sets her suitcase down again.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm sorry. Oh... Now I remember. I said I'd heard your name before, didn't I? Hilda told me.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: She said if I ever met %s, you'd help me. That someone dear to a god would help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Hilda? Where is she now?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes. Hilda's my friend. She came to me one day, needing somewhere to hide. She told me the night had begun.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I didn't see her for a while, but then she found my hiding place and told me to run again... I don't know where she is now.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I told her to come back whenever she wanted to see Nero...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nero?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: My cat familiar. Where did he go, anyway? Nero! Nero!
(At Lepica's call, winged cats flock down from all over Moksha's sky.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Aaaaah! One at a time! Don't all come at once! Why did you split into dozens of cats the moment we got here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Winged cats? They look like the one Trisha described...)
(The cats called Nero ignore her and start rubbing against her. All dozens of them.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, you idiot! I haven't taken my allergy medicine today!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Achoo! Ah-CHOO!
(Startled by Lepica's sneezing, the cats scatter into the air. But they soon come back, determined to snuggle into her arms.)
Meow!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Aaaaah, Nero! What are you doing? We need to go somewhere? We can't do it here?
Meow! Meow!
(Dozens of Neros grab Lepica and lift her into the air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nero? Nero! Where are you taking Lepica?!
Meow! Meow! Meow!
(The chorus of meows is loud enough to fill all of Moksha.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s, Nero found a way out of Moksha! He found what I've spent a whole week looking for!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we need to do...?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Achoo! Ah-choo!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: ...These blasted allergies. Phew. We can't do it here. Wait, let me listen to Nero. Huh? We have to do that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Hey, %s. His idea sounds pretty good. I've already come up with a plan...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: If Nero bothers you, just put up with it, okay? Don't get angry.
(Dozens of Neros fly over and block %s's view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what? I don't mind you coming over, but please keep your fur out of my mouth... Huh?
(By the time the cats fly away and clear the view, Lepica is gone from where the other Neros were holding her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepica? Lepica, where are you? Nero, where did you take her? Aagh!
(At that moment, a swarm of Neros swoops in to attack, as though acting on a signal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is what she meant by putting up with Nero... Does she really have a plan?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have much choice. I'll have to trust Lepica. Let's keep moving. Something will work out.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You made it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haah... Haah... Can I take a break?
(Lepica looks sympathetically at the exhausted %s.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You must be worn out. But we don't have time to rest...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I know this sounds ridiculous, but I don't think it'll work if you stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Nero tell you that?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes. He heard it from a friend he met outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A friend?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero split into all these cats when we entered Moksha, but he got a special ability, too. He can come and go as he likes, even while I'm stuck here.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: He's been talking to people and his animal friends, looking for a way out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that's why he went to Trisha. But an animal friend...?)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: He asked the griffin leader how to leave Moksha. It said we have to unleash an enormous amount of energy, whatever kind we can, and shake Moksha itself.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: And we have to let go of all our desires and stray thoughts while we do it. What kind of solution is that? Ugh...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I came here to try it safely on my own, but I couldn't make it work.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I had a backup plan, though. One that involved you. Remember when I told you to put up with Nero?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I remember.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Other than that monster over there, we're probably the only ones here strong enough to shake this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait, Lepica. What exactly are you suggesting?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I don't like it either, but let's put everything else aside and focus on getting out.
(Lepica takes several different potions from her bag and slips the bottles between her fingers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepica?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: We have to clash our powers together to shake Moksha. Even if neither of us wants to fight. We can't stay trapped here forever, never getting to do the things we want.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: We have to do this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's our only way out, then we don't have a choice. I'll do it. I'll try.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Trust me. I know what I'm doing. Here goes!
(Potion stoppers fly into Moksha's sky.)
(Lepica rummages in her suitcase. Startled, she opens it wide. Only two potions remain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepica, we're running out of time. Hurry! The monster's getting faster.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: ...I know. But what do we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'm almost out of potions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry, Lepica. We've done everything we can. It'll work out...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: All right. You trusted me just as I trusted you. I'll put my faith in this moment.
(The monster draws closer. Towering over them, it raises an arm to smash the ground.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Here we go again!
(As the potion bottles open, the great griffin's cry heard in the village echoes from somewhere beyond.)
(At that same moment, %s's attack strikes the flowing potion, charged with powerful magic.)
KRA-BOOOOM!
(The purple liquid reacts to the force, bursting skyward with a thunderous roar. It explodes like fireworks, filling all of Moksha.)
(Little by little, the distant fog begins to clear.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I-I don't believe it! %s, do you see that? Do you see it?
(As the fog clears, the approaching monster begins to fade. Through it, the ruins slowly come into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Did we do it?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Don't you know you're never supposed to say that at a time like this? Say that, and it'll come back—
(As if on cue, the fading monster struggles into motion again.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: What do we do now?
Meow!

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, I'm out of potions...
Meow!
(Lepica stands stunned until Nero swats her on the head.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Ow! That hurts! Will you stop calling me a useless witch? Shut up and listen to you? How do we get out?
(Before she has finished speaking, dozens of Neros sweep in, grab them both, and haul them into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Achoo! Ah-CHOO! Nero, honestly!
Meow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaah! Nero?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: The fog's coming back! Hold on tight!
Meow! MEOOOOW!
(With a chorus of piercing meows, they fly through Moksha's fog toward the sky above the ruins.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Achoo! Ah-CHOO!

steps.name: The Place the Cry Pointed To
steps.objective: Talk to [Trisha] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then turn in the quest to [Caluso] in 「Invernel Ruins」.

lines.text: (There is nothing to hear, nothing to see. No part of the body will move.)
(Consciousness lingers, but waking seems impossible. Then a peculiar sound cuts through the haze.)
Achoo! Ah-CHOO!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That sound... And what's on my face? Why is it so heavy? What... What happened to me?)
Nero, don't sit on people's faces.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nero? Oh, that's Lepica's voice.)
(A hand reaches up and lifts the weight away. Light slowly returns to the sightless world.)
Meow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I awake now, you ask?
Meow. ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Nero. You've been sitting on my face this whole...
(Moving Nero aside, the adventurer sees three girls looking down at them.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You've got Nero's fur in your mouth.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Trisha, %s seems all right. They're even talking to the cat.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: So was I, remember? Nero, %s is still a little dazed. Come here, will you?
(Nero meets Trisha's eyes, then flies into her arms.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, don't forget whose familiar you are. Your wings haven't gone away, though...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Should I get rid of them for you? Ow! If you like your wings, just say so! Why hit your owner?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Lepica, were you really in Moksha?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Yes. Thanks to %s, Nero and I got out.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I thought it was just a legend. I can't believe it's a real place.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Claire, the world is full of unbelievable things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see you've already introduced yourselves. You all know each other's names. But why was I lying here?

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: You fell out of the sky.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: All of a sudden, Nero turned back into one cat. Apparently he couldn't carry us, so he just let go. Heartless little creature.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Ahaha... So that's how you got knocked out...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew... You'd think I'd be used to it by now, but it never gets any easier.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What sort of things do you get up to...?
(At that moment, a griffin's tremendous cry fills the Invernel Ruins.)
(Startled, Trisha nearly drops Nero. Fortunately, he flaps his wings and takes flight.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: ...Nirvana? That's Nirvana. That's how he used to call for me.
(Tears well in Trisha's eyes as she speaks the name she has missed so dearly. Nero quietly licks them away.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, that's the griffin leader, isn't it?
Meow, meow, meooow. Mew.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: What's Nero saying?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: The door to the Tears of Nornir is open. The one who serves the God of the Astral Realm must hurry... ?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Trisha should go home with Claire...? It's Nirvana, isn't it? Nirvana...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: So the griffin leader's name is Nirvana.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: I thought it might be... But it's strange that Trisha can only hear him now.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: It's as if time and space have fallen out of step.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: %s, that's why you're here, isn't it? What you're looking for must be over there. Nirvana is calling for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero and I should be going.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: You're leaving already?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: But we've only just met...

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You two should go back to the village, like Nirvana said. It won't be safe here. Things are happening that none of us expected.
Meow.
(Nero draws a large circle with his front paws.)

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Thank you, Nero.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: ...I still don't understand. But I can't just stay here. I'll go back and find a way to protect the village.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: The village should be fine. Nero says they'll leave as soon as they get what they want...

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Hmm... Well, that's a relief, at least...

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Claire, let's go back. All we can do for now is wait in the village.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: All right, Trisha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where will you go, Lepica?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Somewhere without witches. I don't know where that is, but there must be somewhere safe. I can't keep hiding here forever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do know one safe place.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a goddess statue at the Eidos Sanctuary Gateway. Stand before it and say you're Hilda's friend, that %s sent you, and that you need somewhere safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you'll be taken to the safe place where Hilda stayed.
(Lepica's eyes light up with delight.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: I'll repay you twice over someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, those words...?)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Then goodbye! Goodbye, everyone. We'll meet again, okay? Once it's safe for me, I'll bring Nero to visit the Invernel Safe Zone. I promise.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: All right, Lepica. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Take care. I hope you'll be safe. And do come visit... Lepica, may Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Mm... No one's ever wished me happiness like that before... I like Nornir, too. May you have Nornir's happiness. Mm.
(As Lepica sniffles, Nero jumps up and kicks her with his hind legs.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Nero, could you please stop kicking your owner to make her pull herself together?

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Take care, everyone. And %s, finish what you came to do and stay safe, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Goodbye.
(Lepica stretches and beams. She takes one remaining pink potion from her suitcase and pours it onto the ground.)
(A moment later, a structure like the gate at the Nereis Gateway rises from the spot.)

lines.speaker: 레피카
lines.text: Good thing I still had this one. All right, goodbye for real this time! Bye!
(Lepica gives a salute in farewell and hurries through the gate with Nero. The instant she enters, it vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: That wasn't magic, but she has such strange powers... Do you think Lepica might be one of those people?

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: Shh.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Yes, Trisha. I know.

lines.speaker: 트리샤
lines.text: %s, Claire and I will wait for you in the village. You promised nothing bad would happen. Please keep that promise.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: %s, tell us what's going on when you get the chance. It's a little frustrating being in the dark.

lines.speaker: 에클레어
lines.text: Father Caluso usually patrols over there at this hour. He says he sometimes senses a faint holy power from that direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Trisha. Claire. Then let me say it, too... May Nornir bless your time with happiness.
(Eclair and Trisha answer %s's blessing with bright smiles, then hurry back to the village.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Time to get back to work. They said it was over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go find the Tear of Time.

steps.name: Yesterday, Today, and Tomorrow
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Caluso] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then enter 「Tears of Nornir」.
2. Defeat [Gremory Queen] in 「Tears of Nornir」 and obtain the <Key to the Other Side>. Then return to [Caluso] in 「Invernel Ruins」 and turn in the quest.

lines.text: (A man in neat priestly robes scratches his chin and surveys his surroundings. Something about him looks decidedly disreputable.)
Romalius left his work and came running, so there must be something nearby. But I can't see a thing.
Try to concentrate a little harder, Romalius. I'll bill the Order separately for your trouble. Though you'll have to forgive the delay in payment.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Thank you, Father Caluso.
(Caluso tugs at his mustache and chuckles.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I can't expect talented people to work for free. Heh. Besides, it's not my money.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Father Caluso, you have a truly frightening face.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I don't care to hear that from a demon. Enough nonsense. Do you sense anything?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: ...It's faint, but there's an immense magical presence over there. That doesn't feel like an ordinary demon...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Could this have something to do with %s's arrival?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I wouldn't rule it out. Speak of the griffin and it appears. Here comes our adventurer now.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Romal, where did you learn that saying? We don't say that in the Highlands...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Welcome, %s.
(Romalius waves as %s approaches.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Romalius, there you are. And you must be Father Caluso?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Are you %s, by any chance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He looks frightening...)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: As High Priest of Resedia, I must ask you to verify your identity. Do you have any identification?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Please don't take my expression the wrong way. This is simply how I look. People sometimes find me intimidating.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, of course...
(Caluso looks at the imperial authorization card in %s's hand with admiration.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: %s, recognized by the imperial court and the Order... Everything is in order. I am Caluso, High Priest of the Resedia Order, also known as the Order of Seres.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: It feels a little embarrassing to call myself a High Priest. Haha. These days, I'm more helpless than high-ranking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I lost a great deal of my holy power fighting demons. My own inadequacy was to blame.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Haha, I'm not ill or in pain. I only regret that I can no longer take part in major battles.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The days of Caluso, the Mad Battle Priest, are behind me...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Ah, I've gone on long enough. Shall we get to the matter at hand?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Am I correct in understanding that you are working to help Iris, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... That's close enough, I think.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Understood.
(Caluso and Romalius suddenly slow down, then return to normal. It happens several more times.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Is time being distorted...?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You felt it too, Romalius. And you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You both felt something? Right now, time around me is...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: You can explain later.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: ...This presence...
(Sensing something, Romalius quietly steps forward.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Romalius, there's nothing there.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Both of you, come over here a moment.
(Where Romalius stands is a stone doorway, much like the entrance to Moksha.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The Order erected stone gates all over Invernel long ago. But there's definitely something different about this one.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: And what is this...?
(Caluso picks up something lying before the gate.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: A black fragment shaped like a butterfly...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Similar to the Grand Duke's, but not his. That heavy scent of greed...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The Gremory Queen is here. She assisted the Grand Duke in the Demon Realm, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Wait. By the Grand Duke, you mean Barbatos? And what's the Gremory Queen doing here...?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Given the Gremory clan's powers, it's not impossible. Could that be why you've come, %s...?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: To enter the realm of time...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You know them both, Father Caluso?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Indeed I do. I know less of the Gremory Queen, but the Grand Duke and I...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Long ago, during a war, a former pontiff came here with a group of refugees and discovered a strange place.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: No one knows what happened inside, but he is said to have sealed it after emerging.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I suspect this place, where we can now sense the demons' power, is the very same. Are you sure you wish to proceed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I have to put right.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Understood. One more thing: have you felt the flow of time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Just now, I felt time distort, the same as you both did.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: If the Gremory Queen entered, there must be a divine treasure inside connected to time.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I suspect the Grand Duke is the one who needs it. But the moment the Queen sees that treasure, she'll claim it for herself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It's simply her nature. The Grand Duke knows it, too.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: And he sent her in to find the treasure, knowing that?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: We'll have to see for ourselves, Father Caluso. For now, it's only my guess.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: A remarkably convincing guess. You really are a valuable asset. I'll have to ask the Order to raise your hourly rate.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Thank you, Father.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the Queen's that dangerous, I can't afford to wait here.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: One moment, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The former pontiff passed away not long after leaving the realm of time. The distorted time had taken its toll on him.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: So he left a prayer for the great soul who would one day enter after him.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: As High Priest of the Resedia Order, I shall recite it. I never imagined I would meet someone bound for the Tears of Nornir...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The Tears of Nornir... A fine name. But what is Nornir?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The collective name for the gods who preside over past, present, and future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Father Caluso.
(Caluso closes his eyes and rests a hand on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: O time of Nornir. O Nornir of time. Day and night, sun and moon, yesterday, today, and tomorrow. May happiness fill the time you hold within you.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: And...
(As Caluso continues his prayer, a mysterious light blooms before him.)

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Father Caluso. It seems Nornir has answered.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Hm?
(Caluso opens his eyes. A veil resembling a magical portal stretches across the doorway.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Where is %s?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: The light reached out and took them inside. As if something within was pulling them in.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I hope that light was Nornir. I wish we could help, but we're not even permitted to enter.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: ...Let's wait here for now. The Grand Duke may be watching from somewhere.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I'd rather not meet him again under these circumstances. Phew. I'll send Lydia a message and see if she's nearby.
(As Caluso recites his prayer, a sudden griffin's cry shakes the ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa! I'm going to fall—
THUD!
(It is not only %s who is shaken. A malicious foe's sharp scythe misses its mark and strikes the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Gremory Queen.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Oh, my.
(The Gremory Queen regards the adventurer with feigned surprise.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: You are lucky, just as the Grand Duke said. Death was right before your eyes, yet somehow you slipped past it. How curious.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Almost as if you'd entrusted your life to that griffin...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That griffin... Hehe.
(A knowing smile crosses the Gremory Queen's face. She lifts her fallen scythe with ease.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Look where you're standing, %s.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The tears shed by gods, buried within the realm of time. Here lies what we both seek.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Tears of Nornir?
(Looking around, the adventurer finds Caluso and Romalius gone. The ruined landscape, with Invernel Temple in the distance, has vanished as well.)
(At the center of a vast temple, strange objects move slowly within gleaming metal tracks, like the workings of a clock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (When did I get here...? No. This is just like entering Moksha.)
(The Gremory Queen sneers as %s looks around in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Still haven't grasped the situation? Watching you flounder, I can't imagine why he thought I should be cautious. Ah, well.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Look at me, %s. Let's make a wager.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A wager?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: We'll search these vast Tears of Nornir for the treasure. The first to find it takes the other's life.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Though first, I intend to dispose of that ill-mannered griffin.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: What do you say?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: %s, do you imagine I'm asking for your consent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. That's how demons do things. You'll do whatever you please, just like the Grand Duke.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Comparing me to the Grand Duke... How do I describe this complicated feeling? Hehe. I'll make an exception and forgive—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't get the wrong idea, Gremory Queen.
(The Gremory Queen's expression twists for an instant, then smooths as though nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I wonder which of us has the wrong idea, %s.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: The moment I find the treasure, I'll personally take your impudent life. Right where you stand... But first, that meddlesome griffin...
(The Gremory Queen gives a chilling smile. Everything around her stops moving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Queen!
(The adventurer lunges forward, but the Queen has vanished as though into thin air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Too late. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's clearly as dangerous as the Grand Duke. I have no choice. I have to find the Tear of Time before she does.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?
(As %s steps farther into the Tears of Nornir, a vast shadow falls overhead.)
(A great creature stills its powerful wings and stands tall, gazing at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana, aren't you?
(Unlike the ordinary griffins of the Highlands, this creature has a bearing of steadfast courage. It nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You understand me.
“Collect yourself, %s!”
(With the griffin's great cry, a voice echoes inside %s's mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what? That feels like Lord Atkina's dragon speech...

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Cast aside your doubts and look upon me. I am the griffin Trisha named Nirvana.”
(Nirvana meets the adventurer's eyes and tries to approach, but collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “That does not matter now, %s. I had to save you before myself. You have already failed to find the Tear of Time before the Gremory Queen many times.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. What do you mean... ?

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Since setting foot in the Highlands, you have died and awakened again, over and over.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Yes, you cannot believe it... Of course you cannot. But I had no choice.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “To protect this place is to protect Trisha. It is my path to atonement. I had to help you.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “To turn back time here, so you could rise again.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... Those moments when time seemed to slow...

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “The distortions you felt were the moments you returned from death and began anew.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Nngh...”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana!

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “...I am... I am all right. Listen to me. If you do not claim the Tear of Time, the Gremory Queen will become more than a demon...”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “She will become a demon god. That was the future I last saw before turning back time.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “This is our final chance. I have no more time.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean... ?

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “You are correct. Turning back time has consumed nearly all the time I had left.”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “...When the last of my time runs out, I may become a beast ruled only by instinct, and stand in your way.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana...

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “Hurry, %s. Protect Iris, Trisha, and everyone else. Through every moment of our lives...”

lines.speaker: 니르바나
lines.text: “...If the worst should happen, use the ▒▒ of ▒▒ dropped by ▒▒▒▒ to ▒▒ the ▒▒...”
(With those words, Nirvana struggles into the air again. But he falls out of sight before he can get far.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana?! Nirvana!
(The adventurer rushes forward, but Nirvana is nowhere to be seen.)
(Drawn by the commotion, the inhabitants of the realm of time slowly emerge before %s.)
(Beings formed of time, spirits, even stray copies of Lepica's cat familiar Nero. All fix their attention on the intruder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stare all you like. I have to survive and see this through to the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So stay out of the time I have left!
(In this lonely place of wandering time, morning gradually darkens toward night, as though marking the end of the Tears of Nornir.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like I can see time passing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was morning when I started, and now it's night... An entire day, and it felt so short.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is the Tear of Time? I've searched every path and still can't find it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be...
(As %s hurries down the darkening path, the blade of a huge scythe sweeps in from the side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Queen!
(The Gremory Queen smiles as %s retreats. She rushes forward, swinging her scythe.)
(The adventurer tries to counter, but the Queen's overwhelming attack sends them flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Did you think reliving these moments made you a little stronger? You still cannot reach me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know... ?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I am the queen of demons who command time. Did you think I wouldn't notice?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Realizing Nirvana was denying me my future as a demon god was most upsetting.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: How cruel the gods are. They banished a Pluton Dragon for trespassing in their realm, yet sentenced him to guard that very realm for eternity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Nirvana used to be a Pluton Dragon?)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: I have claimed the Tear of Time exactly forty-six times since entering, only to be sent back. It's getting tiresome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forty-six times... ?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Yes. You've died forty-six times as well, %s. Aren't you tired of it?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Or perhaps not. The many other versions of you have died in other timelines, too. So the total must be higher.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: You are fascinating. Just what are you? A mere human, yet somehow... How did you come to be this way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm just me.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: What an answer. You really don't know yourself. Then allow me, who has touched the Tear of Time, to explain—
(A sharp attack grazes the Gremory Queen's face. Dark green blood trickles from a cut in her pale cheek.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: ...Heh.
(The Gremory Queen chuckles and strokes her cheek. The wound vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to hear it. I don't need to.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Then I'll take that to mean you'll focus on the Tear of Time. Shall we enjoy ourselves?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Oh, this will be delightful. The divine messenger who could revive you has spent all his time and become a beast of pure instinct.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Even this realm's guardian has begun to run mad.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: And I shall erase every last trace of your soul. This forty-seventh cycle will be the last. I will become a demon god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does a demon want with godhood... ?

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: At least I'll be better than someone who never wished to become a god.
(Hearing what seems to be a reference to Iris, %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: ...So eager to throw yourself at me and be disposed of.

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Watch closely, %s. Behold my rebirth, from Queen of the Gremory to Dahlia, the Demon God!
(At the Gremory Queen's cry, darkness deepens throughout the Tears of Nornir. Her time and %s's flow toward their final moment.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Stubborn human. How have you lasted this long...?
(The adventurer barely fends off the Queen's attacks, enduring until her face twists in frustration.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Even more persistent than the thirty-second time. Disgusting.
(The horn on the Queen's forehead becomes a sharp blade and pierces %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-aaargh!

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: Still determined to hold on? It's been so long since a human refused to yield to this much pain—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I can't give up! I have to stop you and get the Tear of Time...!

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: What a pitiful sight.
(The Gremory Queen wipes the blood from her horn and looks down at the fallen %s.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: You have no chance left in this timeline. I'll end it quickly and painlessly.
(As the Queen smiles, magic erupts from her scythe. At that instant, something flies past her ear into the air.)
(Seeing that the object in the adventurer's hand is gone, the Gremory Queen whips her head around.)

lines.speaker: 그레모리 퀸
lines.text: That's...
(The Gremory Queen reaches out to wield her power over time, but the object is already hurtling toward the structure suspended at the center of the Tears of Nornir.)
(The throw might have fallen short. But Nirvana, somehow awake again, catches the object in his beak and flies straight into the structure.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana?
KRA-BOOOOOM!
(A blinding flash and a deafening roar fill the Tears of Nornir.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, so bright...
(The adventurer shields their eyes. The light soon fades, and they lower their arm to find an uncanny sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything's stopped...
(The Queen is frozen with her hand outstretched toward the flying object. Even her sharp scythe, once brimming with magic, gives off nothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That thing moving at the center of the Tears of Nornir... It was the Tear of Time all along.
“...If the worst should happen, use the Key of Time dropped by a Timekeeper to...”
“...Destroy the Tear of Time...”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only did what Nirvana told me... I never expected this. Nirvana...? Nirvana!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana, where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me, Nirvana! Nirvana?
(%s rushes toward where the Tear of Time stood, then stops short.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Excellent work, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Though Nirvana, once a messenger of the gods, told you how to resolve this... Only you could have accomplished it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can visit this place for the first time in ages.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As Dahlia said, only those who could wield time were permitted inside the Tears of Nornir...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But with the Tear of Time, the very essence of this place, gone, that restriction no longer matters.
(Barbatos looks forlornly at the spot where the Tear of Time once stood.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to Nirvana...? I haven't found him.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It was his choice. Nirvana's... No, Sanak's.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A Pluton Dragon, banished for gazing into the realm of the gods.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Yet the god did not hate him. He was allowed to remain in the Highlands, where the Tear of Time had fallen, in the hope that he would repent.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Around the time the Beast appeared... I don't know how he became a griffin, but he lived in the Highlands in that form for many years.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And it seems he formed a bond with a human girl.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ten years ago, when I awakened and appeared here, he must have returned to this place to protect her.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Perhaps he made this choice for her sake, just as he once protected a god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: For a god's own creation to destroy an object imbued with divine power... That speaks to his resolve.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He must have known that defying providence would cost him his very existence...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nirvana...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Without even knowing who its true master was... Well, it no longer matters.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I simply wanted to obtain an object I needed. Nirvana and Dahlia ruined everything.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Though I expected as much from the moment Dahlia sensed its divine power...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your grip on your weapon is tightening, %s. Fighting here would only cost you.
(Barbatos smirks at %s's startled reaction.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You remain so easy to read.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This divine realm, stripped of time, will soon drift into a gap in the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I shall leave the gods' domain to the gods. One who has yet to regain godhood should take his leave. Even a great being cannot easily escape those gaps...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And the day of your trial is fast approaching...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: ...You may look forward to it.
(The adventurer tries to seize Barbatos, but a black butterfly appears and circles him. They vanish together.)
(As the adventurer stares at the empty space, a black hole opens before them. Through it looms the shadow of the monster from Moksha.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to get out...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which way do I go?
(A small light approaches %s. It circles %s, then reveals a path that was invisible a moment before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That way...? I suppose it's my only option...

steps.name: Wishing You Happy Times
steps.objective: Talk to [Caluso] in 「Invernel Ruins」, then visit 「Pneuma」 and turn in the quest to [Arche].

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: Father Caluso.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: That woman's power... The Gremory Queen's power has diminished. No, it seems to have stopped moving. She isn't dead, though...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: And the Grand Duke's faint presence has vanished, too.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: If Barbatos has left, he has no further business here. Either %s succeeded, or failed.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I'd call it a success. Look, Father.
(Where Romalius points, a mysterious light gathers before the gate and rises like a temple pillar.)
(When the light fades, the person they have been waiting for stands there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm outside...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: You've returned, %s.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Are you all right, %s? It hasn't even been ten minutes since I prayed for you and you went inside...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ten minutes?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Judging by your reaction, %s, time must flow differently in there.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: In any case, I'm glad you've returned safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: If you don't mind, %s, could you briefly tell us what happened inside?

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: The pontiff may already know, since I recited that prayer... But I should still make a proper report.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. You helped me, after all. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I give Caluso a brief account of what happened in the Tears of Nornir, including the forty-six repetitions of time.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: A most fascinating account...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Trisha's griffin was a divine messenger... And to protect everyone, he destroyed a divine relic, knowing he would cease to exist...

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: When Barbatos said he would become a god, I thought it was just cult nonsense...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Then the Grand Duke has left the Highlands, and the Gremory Queen is trapped in a world of stopped time, drifting into a gap in spacetime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it's resolved, for now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time hasn't slowed and returned to normal since I got out...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's over. Does that mean I can go back to Iris?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...?
(A small orb of light appears beside %s and circles them.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: ...Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Hello, Father Caluso.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I'm honored that you know my name, Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I was a little worried when I couldn't find you, %s. But I'm all right now.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Everything is back to normal. I'm so glad I can hear your voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have so much to tell you, Iris. But there's somewhere I need to go before I come back to you.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: All right. I'll wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(At %s's reply, the sacred light drifts away on the breeze.)

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: ...I never dreamed I would see that sacred light so close.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: I wanted to hear the goddess's voice, too. I suppose being a demon made that impossible. Ah, well. Perhaps I'll have to be reborn.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Take heart, young demon. When the time comes, the goddess will understand your intentions, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Is your work here finished, then?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to tell Trisha about Nirvana before I leave.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: ...Allow me to find the right moment to tell her. I fear it would be too much for her to take in right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see... Then I'll leave that to you, Father.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye to you, too, Romalius. Good luck with your work.

lines.speaker: 로말리우스
lines.text: It was a pleasure meeting you, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: 칼루소
lines.text: I pray for your safe return, %s. May Nornir bless your time with happiness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time filled with happiness...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do my best to make that wish come true.

steps.name: To Pneuma and Elysia
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then find [Irfan] in 「Elysia」. Then turn in the quest to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid」.

lines.text: (The moment Arche sees %s arrive in Pneuma, she rushes over and throws her arms around them.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, I'm so glad you're safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, I-I can't breathe.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry.
(Arche steps back. Her eyes are badly swollen.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, dear... My eyes must be all puffy.
(At Arche's gesture, an Aerura flies over and rubs against her face.)
(Miraculously, the swelling vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aeruras can do that, too?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They're very helpful friends. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now that your time has returned, %s, the spirits in Pneuma have their energy back, too!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Chronos and Kairos are all right, too?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You have no idea how happy I am to see them bickering again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wish I could say everything will be all right now, that nothing more will happen. But I don't know.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm afraid of what else might happen to you and Iris, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be all right, Arche. Try not to worry so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia wouldn't want to see you so anxious, either.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Are you on your way to see Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After I've thanked everyone who helped me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I see. Irfan is next, then?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I'm sorry I can't stay longer, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's all right, %s. You can come back another time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I promise I will. See you soon.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: See you!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You're back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your help, Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You needn't thank me. Save your gratitude for her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please thank Hecate for me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That hardly sounds heartfelt. Still, I shall pass on her words.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: She commends you for handling the situation surprisingly well. It was almost as though a god of mischief had intervened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I appreciate the praise, but none of this was a joke...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Have something more to say? Then catch and kill the serpent behind the mischief first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Whether it's a blessing or not, you can now freely visit the place that was the Reverse Side.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The path to Yggdrasil's Reverse Side will remain open.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't look so surprised. Go and see.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Someone there seems to be waiting for news of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Irfan. Until next time.

steps.name: Rift in Time
steps.objective: Talk to [Ellie] in 「Vigrid」, then meet [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」 in 「Eidos Sanctuary」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: How did you come back here? Wait a moment...
(Ellie smiles through brimming eyes. She wipes them with her sleeve, but cannot hide her tears of joy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ellie, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I believed in you. I knew you'd resolve everything happening in your time on both the Reverse Side and the Front Side...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's thanks to you, Ellie.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I don't know who you wanted me to give your regards to. I can't even remember exactly what you said...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: No, you've already passed them on. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have? What do you mean... ?

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don't have to understand just yet. You will someday. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: ...I'd love to hear your story, but you're only stopping by Vigrid, aren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I need to see Iris.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Of course. You look as though you need the comfort Iris brings you. You may say you're fine, but you've lived through so many different currents of time...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: I'm sorry there's nothing I can do for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't say that, Ellie.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: You don't know how happy that makes me. So...

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Come and visit from time to time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Then off you go... You can return from the place where we first met in Vigrid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll see you again, Ellie.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll have to visit Lord Atkina and Jiendia later. There isn't time... I need to see Iris first...)
(Ellie waves broadly as she watches %s leave.)

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Jiendia must have met Crown Prince Guiyi again by now. Take care of yourself, Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 엘리
lines.text: Ouroboros...?
(Iris greets %s with a radiant smile. The adventurer's tension melts away, and they sink to the ground in relief.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... I couldn't help it...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You always say you're fine, %s. Though I suppose I do, too.
(Iris offers %s a hand and helps them stand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. So much happened. I wish I could have come back sooner...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did anything happen to you while I was away?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I couldn't move freely. If I'd tried to approach you, %s, I might have destabilized time, including the Great Wall...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Iris. I want to rest, but I have so much to talk to you about. Do you have time?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: We have plenty of time. There's no need to hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I talk to Iris about?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Her Majesty told me to watch without interfering. But the moment I tried to save Jiendia, time and space split into a Front Side and a Reverse Side, with me at the center.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I put things right in Vigrid, on the Reverse Side, and returned to the Front Side.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I lived through the same stretch of time over and over, fighting the Gremory Queen for the Tear of Time, the treasure of the realm of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I barely escaped by following Nirvana's instructions, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would have happened if I'd followed Her Majesty's prophecy? It hadn't bothered me until now, but the moment I saw you, I started wondering.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll tell you everything I know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Empress Kaina saw more than one future. Your journey through Vigrid and the Highlands was among them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Then... Does that mean... ?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: She pieced together fragments of those futures to point you toward the best outcome. The rest she entrusted to you, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...I think she knew you would save Jiendia, and that you would resolve everything and return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, Lord Atkina once told me something. That Her Majesty's power was almost divine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That she might be a demigod, or something like one.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know if that's what she is. But as I learned of the Tears of Nornir and felt their effects, I realized something.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Empress Kaina is also looking into the gaps in the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it all makes sense. It does, but...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I know it's hard to accept. That's all I can tell you about Her Majesty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll figure out the rest somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to find out what Her Majesty is hiding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you feel it, too, Iris? All those times that time reversed inside the Tears of Nornir...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. Though I couldn't reach you... I felt every moment that everything you were began to fade, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forty-six times. Every one of them...
(Iris nods, sadness in her eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should have put things right sooner.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right. You're here in front of me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. If you say it's all right, then it is. Right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Exactly. If I say it's all right, it's all right. Who's going to argue with Etoile's God of the Astral Realm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Iris, as you know, I've been different people in different branches of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know which one was the real me. But the person standing here before you must be me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I vaguely remember it. At some point, your name began to surface in my mind, as if it had been carved there. I became certain I had to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As if it were destiny, regardless of my past or my own will. Of course, now I believe I belong at your side, whatever brought me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there's something I want to ask. When did you first become aware of me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When I was dreaming, at a moment when I needed someone...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: A door opened, and a path appeared. And there, I saw you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw that door in a dream, too... Sorry, I don't think I saw you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Whatever happened, I'm glad we were able to meet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The path in the dream... Was it really a dream?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There are many realms of time besides the Tears of Nornir. I don't know what forms they take...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But they must be as varied as time is boundless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If something like this happens again, I'll have to visit another place like the Tears of Nornir.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll keep watch over the Great Wall and do what I can to prevent that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the Gremory Queen is trapped in there, with time stopped?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes. Neither alive nor dead, she will remain there. Subject only to the time she so desperately wanted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did the Grand Duke plan even that... ?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: If a god who knew Barbatos were nearby, I could ask them. But we still know so little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A god who knows the Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I thought of her, too. But I understand it's difficult for her to leave Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then I'll have to find out for myself...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hilda's friend who came with a cat? They were arguing terribly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lepica made it. That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Like Hilda, Lepica was on the run because she didn't want to hurt anyone, or be killed herself.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thanks to you, %s, I've met someone I can enjoy talking to. I'm so happy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you've found someone you enjoy talking to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Lepica now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Where Hilda stayed before. It's a place people can remain only with my permission.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When the time is right, let's go together. With our friends.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry too much about Lepica. She's kind, lively, and optimistic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.
(A few black cat hairs cling to Iris's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. What sort of place does Iris mean? I'm curious, but it can wait...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris, could I... rest here for a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I've relaxed, I can barely keep my eyes open. I'm so sleepy...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course. As long as you like.
(Hearing Iris's answer, the adventurer lies down in the flower bed behind them. Looking up at Iris, they close their eyes and drift off.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You'll be uncomfortable without a pillow... Is there something I could use? Whenever I slept like this, my grandmother always brought me a pillow...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...Grandmother...?
(As Iris searches for something to put beneath %s's head, she is startled by the word that has slipped from her lips.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Why... Why have I forgotten my grandmother all this time...?!
Surely you did not forget her because you wished to.
(A small, dark orb appears before Iris. Faint light seeps from it, spreading until it fills the Oracle Chamber.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...Hecate? Lady Hecate?
(As the mistlike light disperses, a woman dressed in black appears at its center and approaches Iris.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Iris. Child who has succeeded Seres.
(Hecate smiles faintly at Iris, draws her into a gentle embrace, and whispers in her ear.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You were speaking of me with that mortal.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Hecate, I...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Forgive me, child. I did not mean to frighten you. Please understand.
(Hecate steps back and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: One of Gaia's chambers, if I recall. And now you use it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: How did you come here?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Let us say I owe it to that sleeping mortal and the Tear of Time.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Child.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: There is something I must receive from you. Something I shared with Seres. Something you, in turn, inherited from her.
(Hecate quietly turns her gaze to the sleeping %s. The adventurer remains deep in sleep, unaware that the Goddess of the Black Moon has arrived.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Child, you know what I want. Do not be afraid.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I have come to collect it myself, but I will not ask you to give it up for nothing.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Child... No. Iris, God of the Astral Realm. I shall grant you a special opportunity.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The chance to live as a human. As an ordinary person...
